own_solution.law: Doppler effect for a moving reflector with stationary source and receiver: f_echo = f (c+u)/(c-u); beat = f_echo - f = 2 u f/(c-u)
assumptions: source and microphone at rest and co-located
wall moves directly towards source at constant u

notes: Base: 440*6/340 = 7.7647 Hz. With wall speed 4.4 m/s: 440*8.8/338.6 = 11.4353 Hz. The 90 m distance (T72F4/TAC5B) enters the wavefront-timing derivation (echo delay) but cancels from the frequency; it could also be read as K (regime: the wall has not yet reached the loudspeaker, i.e. within 30 s of the start), since it only bounds the time window in which an echo exists. Variants: 1.4 m/s in T2729, T811A, T105F, T7F76; 90 m in T72F4/TAC5B; T544D and T1B41 numeral-free ('a little').
